title: Fix persistent black screen on app open by guaranteeing a visible startup UI and fail-safe auth routing

requirements.text: Ensure the app never renders an empty screen during startup by rendering a visible full-screen loading UI from the root route while Internet Identity initialization and the initial user profile query are unresolved.

quotes: It is still a black screen. What the fuck? Fix it now.

acceptanceCriteria: When the app first loads (hard refresh) and auth/profile state is still resolving, the user sees a full-screen loading UI (not a black/blank screen).
This loading UI is shown regardless of which route is initially loaded (e.g., '/', '/login', '/exercises').
The loading UI uses clear English user-facing text.

requirements.text: Update TanStack Router auth/onboarding route guards so that if auth/profile resolution times out or errors, the router renders a safe fallback UI (via router error handling) instead of continuing into a route that may render nothing.

quotes: It is still a black screen. What the fuck? Fix it now.

acceptanceCriteria: If auth/profile resolution fails (e.g., timeout), the UI displays an error/fallback screen consistent with the dark EVRVEST theme (not a black/blank screen).
The fallback screen includes an English explanation and a way to recover (e.g., reload).
Route guards do not swallow failures in a way that allows the app to proceed into an indeterminate state with no visible UI.

requirements.text: Add a deterministic startup recovery path: when auth/profile resolution fails, provide a user-visible option to reset the startup session (e.g., reload application and/or clear any persisted URL/session routing parameters used for navigation) so users can escape a broken state.
acceptanceCriteria: When startup resolution fails, the fallback UI provides a clearly labeled recovery action in English (e.g., “Reload Application”).
Invoking the recovery action results in the app attempting startup again and showing loading/fallback UI as appropriate (never blank).

requirements.text: Add lightweight, production-safe diagnostics for the startup/auth resolution path to help identify remaining black-screen causes (e.g., console warnings with enough context to distinguish identity init vs profile fetch vs router guard stage).

quotes: It is still a black screen. What the fuck? Fix it now.

acceptanceCriteria: On startup issues, console logs clearly indicate which phase is blocked or failed (identity init, profile load, router guard wait).
Diagnostics do not expose sensitive user data.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Keep auth/onboarding redirects implemented through TanStack Router lifecycle (beforeLoad/loader + redirect), not imperative navigation during render.
All user-facing text must be English.
nonGoals: Adding new backend APIs or changing Motoko state/schema as part of this black-screen fix.
